content: Add a dedicated manage-toolchain reference for constructing and explicitly consuming the Ubuntu 20.04/glibc 2.31 target SDK, distinguishing tool materialization from the still-missing product release-build wiring.

Read-only skill review selected an on-demand reference under manage-toolchain and kept Nix materialization, CMake/Ninja product build, packaging, release qualification, Git identity, and host retention with their existing owners.

Read-only implementation audit confirmed that the complete Ubuntu 20.04 SDK and generic LLVM closure exist, while the release preset contains only Release/LTO settings and packaging/build.py installs and validates an existing build tree rather than compiling it.

Document provider-sysroot, ubuntu-20.04-target-sdk, and generic-llvm-toolchain as three distinct inputs. Entering nix develop .#release proves tool availability only; CMake must explicitly select the complete target tuple. GLIBC_2.32 or newer is a consumption failure, not evidence that the SDK is absent.

The signed Ubuntu provenance verifier requires complete explicit InRelease, index, DEB, keyring, and tool arguments and is not wired into routine flake or CTest gates. The guide records the valid invocation shape and leaves a checked-in argument-resolving driver as an activation gap rather than citing a no-argument pass.

A disposable explicit-target CMake build using raw Clang 22.1.8, the complete SDK, static zlib, generic LLVM/MLIR/LLD, path remapping, and the system loader built metafluxd plus both providers. CUDA provider referenced at most GLIBC_2.17, NVML provider GLIBC_2.14, and metafluxd GLIBC_2.29; metafluxd had the system interpreter, allowed system DT_NEEDED entries, no RPATH/RUNPATH, and no embedded Nix store path.

The SDK and generic LLVM Nix outputs materialized successfully, the provenance JSON parsed, bundled skill quick validation passed, git diff checks passed, and tools/check-agent-records.py passed. Disposable /tmp build trees were removed automatically and no logs, evidence archives, GC roots, or source copies were retained.

Content commit 003dce26047fe80cf3ada9bdcfd0312dbc9399c0 adds the dedicated SDK construction and use guide plus mandatory manage-toolchain routing without changing Nix expressions, CMake presets, product code, packaging behavior, or release maturity.
